items.title: HUGE: Jio Takes on Starlink and Launches India's First National Satellite Internet in 2027
items.summary:
Jio satellite internet plans target a major orbital test by September 2027 to expand broadband reach.

Jio is developing a network of 1,600 satellites with a target completion date of 2030. This infrastructure aims to deliver reliable broadband services to underserved regions, including small towns, by establishing 20-22 ground stations across the country.

The project roadmap centers on an initial orbital test scheduled for September 2027. Beyond standard access, the network incorporates direct-to-device connectivity, positioning the operator to provide seamless service in areas where traditional fiber infrastructure remains difficult to deploy.

items.title: WARNING: A New Map Shows What India Cannot Build Yet and the Gaps Are Bigger Than You Think
items.summary:
India Build is now live, creating an open-source tech map to help the nation master 10,000 critical industrial capabilities.

This project, inspired by the BOM Wiki, serves as a comprehensive resource for the country. It catalogs essential industrial capabilities ranging from EDA software to polysilicon and port cranes, providing a clear visual representation of what is required for self-reliance.

By mapping these complex dependencies and technology trees, the project helps stakeholders identify critical gaps and understand the downstream impacts of manufacturing decisions. This tool is designed for planners and decision-makers who need to navigate the nuances of industrial scaling and resource allocation effectively, while providing the foundation for better supply chain mapping.

items.title: Inside An LLM, Words Have Gravity
items.summary: In episode 1025 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Dr. Luis Serrano, Founder of Serrano Academy about his 'aha!' moment understanding transformer attention as words moving in a line, leading to his 'word gravity' analogy. He explains how words like 'river' pull 'bank' towards a nature-related meaning, much like gravity. This unique perspective helps visualize the complex mechanics within large language models.

items.title: ALERT: Agnikul Is Building the Infrastructure to Answer India's Biggest Space Question

The company is scaling its infrastructure to support more efficient spaceflight operations. These new facilities are dedicated to stage testing and inspection, providing a critical pathway for refining their launch technology.

This expansion highlights the growing maturity of India's private space sector, as companies move from design to rigorous testing. By streamlining the recovery and refurbishment process, AgniKul Cosmos aims to increase launch frequency and reduce costs.

items.title: EXPOSED: A Professor Says We Solved It First and OpenAI Is Taking the Credit for His Math Work
items.summary:
OpenAI faces serious questions regarding its approach to solving the Navier-Stokes problem and the use of researcher data. We analyze the allegations of leaked information and the resulting dispute.

The ongoing OpenAI controversy centers on accusations regarding the unauthorized use of academic work. A mathematician has raised concerns about the company's conduct, specifically questioning how significant computational resources were deployed to claim a breakthrough on one of the most difficult challenges in mathematics. This situation highlights the growing tension between private AI labs and the academic community.

We examine the dispute over academic credit for foundational research, which is central to this conflict. This case underscores critical issues in AI research ethics as the industry continues to accelerate its pace of discovery while navigating the long-standing norms of scientific collaboration and attribution.

items.summary:
Amazon and Qualcomm are launching a $60 billion partnership for AI data centers to challenge Nvidia.

Qualcomm is moving beyond smartphone chips to capture the growing demand for silicon optimized for AWS infrastructure. This multi-generational collaboration aims to develop bespoke custom silicon, positioning the company to compete directly in the high-stakes AI chips market.

The agreement outlines a long-term roadmap with significant revenue projections for the supplier by fiscal years 2027 and 2029. Analysts are watching closely as this deal forces a shift in the competitive landscape for AI data centers, potentially diminishing the current dominance of legacy hardware providers.

items.title: HUGE: Mistral AI Just Got a €3 Billion Euro Boost From Samsung
items.summary:

French startup Mistral has secured the largest European tech fundraise to date, with a valuation now exceeding 21 billion euros. This significant capital injection, led by a Samsung investment, is designed to accelerate the development of robust, independent models.

The focus here is on building sovereign AI solutions that reduce reliance on American technology stacks. For industry leaders and decision-makers, this move signals a major shift in the geopolitical balance of the market.

items.title: How AI Agents Work: Tools, Builders & the Internal Architecture
items.summary:
Knowing what an agent can do is one thing. Knowing how it works inside is another, and it is more structured than most people expect.

Give a general-purpose agent a goal and it plans the steps, picks its tools, executes, checks its own results, self-corrects when something looks wrong, and delivers a summary or output files. Plan, act, check, self-correct, deliver. That loop is what separates an agent from a chatbot.

Terms covered:
- Agent Tools: the specific actions an agent can take, from web search to running code to calling APIs
- Tool Builder: creating custom tools so an agent can reach internal databases, custom APIs and legacy systems
- Agent Builder: the environment where you set the agent's goal, tools, instructions and constraints, without deep engineering

The internal loop gives it intelligence. The tools define its reach. The builder is how you put it together.

—
